However, the Li density of the ﬁrst coordination shell in the RDF is signiﬁcantly lower around the O atoms. Integrating the Li density up to 3.5 Å shows that (on average) there are 2.9 Li atoms in the ﬁrst coordination shell of O atoms, and 3.5 Li atoms in the ﬁrst coordination shell of S atoms. This implies that it is unfavorable for Li ions to be near the O atoms in β-Li3PS3.75O0.25, and these Li ions must be accommodated elsewhere within the crystal structure.
